1 class Battle::Scene
    2   #=============================================================================
    3   # Create the battle scene and its elements
    4   #=============================================================================
    5   def initialize
    6     @battle     = nil
    7     @abortable  = false
    8     @aborted    = false
    9     @battleEnd  = false

   13   # Called whenever the battle begins.
   14   def pbStartBattle(battle)
   15     @battle   = battle
   16     @viewport = Viewport.new(0, 0, Graphics.width, Graphics.height)
   17     @viewport.z = 99999
   18     @lastCmd  = Array.new(@battle.battlers.length, 0)
   19     @lastMove = Array.new(@battle.battlers.length, 0)
   20     pbInitSprites
   21     pbBattleIntroAnimation
   22   end

   24   def pbInitSprites
   25     @sprites = {}
   26     # The background image and each side's base graphic
   27     pbCreateBackdropSprites
   28     # Create message box graphic
   29     messageBox = pbAddSprite("messageBox", 0, Graphics.height - 96,
   30                              "Graphics/UI/Battle/overlay_message", @viewport)
   31     messageBox.z = 195
   32     # Create message window (displays the message)
   33     msgWindow = Window_AdvancedTextPokemon.newWithSize(
   34       "", 16, Graphics.height - 96 + 2, Graphics.width - 32, 96, @viewport
   35     )
   36     msgWindow.z              = 200
   37     msgWindow.opacity        = 0
   38     msgWindow.baseColor      = MESSAGE_BASE_COLOR
   39     msgWindow.shadowColor    = MESSAGE_SHADOW_COLOR
   40     msgWindow.letterbyletter = true
   41     @sprites["messageWindow"] = msgWindow
   42     # Create command window
   43     @sprites["commandWindow"] = CommandMenu.new(@viewport, 200)
   44     # Create fight window
   45     @sprites["fightWindow"] = FightMenu.new(@viewport, 200)
   46     # Create targeting window
   47     @sprites["targetWindow"] = TargetMenu.new(@viewport, 200, @battle.sideSizes)
   48     pbShowWindow(MESSAGE_BOX)
   49     # The party lineup graphics (bar and balls) for both sides
   50     2.times do |side|
   51       partyBar = pbAddSprite("partyBar_#{side}", 0, 0,
   52                              "Graphics/UI/Battle/overlay_lineup", @viewport)
   53       partyBar.z       = 120
   54       partyBar.mirror  = true if side == 0   # Player's lineup bar only
   55       partyBar.visible = false
   56       NUM_BALLS.times do |i|
   57         ball = pbAddSprite("partyBall_#{side}_#{i}", 0, 0, nil, @viewport)
   58         ball.z       = 121
   59         ball.visible = false
   60       end
   61       # Ability splash bars
   62       if USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
   63         @sprites["abilityBar_#{side}"] = AbilitySplashBar.new(side, @viewport)
   64       end
   65     end
   66     # Player's and partner trainer's back sprite
   67     @battle.player.each_with_index do |p, i|
   68       pbCreateTrainerBackSprite(i, p.trainer_type, @battle.player.length)
   69     end
   70     # Opposing trainer(s) sprites
   71     if @battle.trainerBattle?
   72       @battle.opponent.each_with_index do |p, i|
   73         pbCreateTrainerFrontSprite(i, p.trainer_type, @battle.opponent.length)
   74       end
   75     end
   76     # Data boxes and Pokémon sprites
   77     @battle.battlers.each_with_index do |b, i|
   78       next if !b
   79       @sprites["dataBox_#{i}"] = PokemonDataBox.new(b, @battle.pbSideSize(i), @viewport)
   80       pbCreatePokemonSprite(i)
   81     end
   82     # Wild battle, so set up the Pokémon sprite(s) accordingly
   83     if @battle.wildBattle?
   84       @battle.pbParty(1).each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
   85         index = (i * 2) + 1
   86         pbChangePokemon(index, pkmn)
   87         pkmnSprite = @sprites["pokemon_#{index}"]
   88         pkmnSprite.tone    = Tone.new(-80, -80, -80)
   89         pkmnSprite.visible = true
   90       end
   91     end
   92   end

   94   def pbCreateBackdropSprites
   95     case @battle.time
   96     when 1 then time = "eve"
   97     when 2 then time = "night"
   98     end
   99     # Put everything together into backdrop, bases and message bar filenames
  100     backdropFilename = @battle.backdrop
  101     baseFilename = @battle.backdrop
  102     baseFilename = sprintf("%s_%s", baseFilename, @battle.backdropBase) if @battle.backdropBase
  103     messageFilename = @battle.backdrop
  104     if time
  105       trialName = sprintf("%s_%s", backdropFilename, time)
  106       if pbResolveBitmap(sprintf("Graphics/Battlebacks/%s_bg", trialName))
  107         backdropFilename = trialName
  108       end
  109       trialName = sprintf("%s_%s", baseFilename, time)
  110       if pbResolveBitmap(sprintf("Graphics/Battlebacks/%s_base0", trialName))
  111         baseFilename = trialName
  112       end
  113       trialName = sprintf("%s_%s", messageFilename, time)
  114       if pbResolveBitmap(sprintf("Graphics/Battlebacks/%s_message", trialName))
  115         messageFilename = trialName
  116       end
  117     end
  118     if !pbResolveBitmap(sprintf("Graphics/Battlebacks/%s_base0", baseFilename)) &&
  119        @battle.backdropBase
  120       baseFilename = @battle.backdropBase
  121       if time
  122         trialName = sprintf("%s_%s", baseFilename, time)
  123         if pbResolveBitmap(sprintf("Graphics/Battlebacks/%s_base0", trialName))
  124           baseFilename = trialName
  125         end
  126       end
  127     end
  128     # Finalise filenames
  129     battleBG   = "Graphics/Battlebacks/" + backdropFilename + "_bg"
  130     playerBase = "Graphics/Battlebacks/" + baseFilename + "_base0"
  131     enemyBase  = "Graphics/Battlebacks/" + baseFilename + "_base1"
  132     messageBG  = "Graphics/Battlebacks/" + messageFilename + "_message"
  133     # Apply graphics
  134     bg = pbAddSprite("battle_bg", 0, 0, battleBG, @viewport)
  135     bg.z = 0
  136     bg = pbAddSprite("battle_bg2", -Graphics.width, 0, battleBG, @viewport)
  137     bg.z      = 0
  138     bg.mirror = true
  139     2.times do |side|
  140       baseX, baseY = Battle::Scene.pbBattlerPosition(side)
  141       base = pbAddSprite("base_#{side}", baseX, baseY,
  142                          (side == 0) ? playerBase : enemyBase, @viewport)
  143       base.z = 1
  144       if base.bitmap
  145         base.ox = base.bitmap.width / 2
  146         base.oy = (side == 0) ? base.bitmap.height : base.bitmap.height / 2
  147       end
  148     end
  149     cmdBarBG = pbAddSprite("cmdBar_bg", 0, Graphics.height - 96, messageBG, @viewport)
  150     cmdBarBG.z = 180
  151   end

  153   def pbCreateTrainerBackSprite(idxTrainer, trainerType, numTrainers = 1)
  154     if idxTrainer == 0   # Player's sprite
  155       trainerFile = GameData::TrainerType.player_back_sprite_filename(trainerType)
  156     else   # Partner trainer's sprite
  157       trainerFile = GameData::TrainerType.back_sprite_filename(trainerType)
  158     end
  159     spriteX, spriteY = Battle::Scene.pbTrainerPosition(0, idxTrainer, numTrainers)
  160     trainer = pbAddSprite("player_#{idxTrainer + 1}", spriteX, spriteY, trainerFile, @viewport)
  161     return if !trainer.bitmap
  162     # Alter position of sprite
  163     trainer.z = 80 + idxTrainer
  164     if trainer.bitmap.width > trainer.bitmap.height * 2
  165       trainer.src_rect.x     = 0
  166       trainer.src_rect.width = trainer.bitmap.width / 5
  167     end
  168     trainer.ox = trainer.src_rect.width / 2
  169     trainer.oy = trainer.bitmap.height
  170   end
  171 
  172   def pbCreateTrainerFrontSprite(idxTrainer, trainerType, numTrainers = 1)
  173     trainerFile = GameData::TrainerType.front_sprite_filename(trainerType)
  174     spriteX, spriteY = Battle::Scene.pbTrainerPosition(1, idxTrainer, numTrainers)
  175     trainer = pbAddSprite("trainer_#{idxTrainer + 1}", spriteX, spriteY, trainerFile, @viewport)
  176     return if !trainer.bitmap
  177     # Alter position of sprite
  178     trainer.z  = 7 + idxTrainer
  179     trainer.ox = trainer.src_rect.width / 2
  180     trainer.oy = trainer.bitmap.height
  181   end

  183   def pbCreatePokemonSprite(idxBattler)
  184     sideSize = @battle.pbSideSize(idxBattler)
  185     batSprite = BattlerSprite.new(@viewport, sideSize, idxBattler, @animations)
  186     @sprites["pokemon_#{idxBattler}"] = batSprite
  187     shaSprite = BattlerShadowSprite.new(@viewport, sideSize, idxBattler)
  188     shaSprite.visible = false
  189     @sprites["shadow_#{idxBattler}"] = shaSprite
  190   end
